verdict.rationale: A built-in app store is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes an app store or one-click app installation. Third-party apps such as Adobe InDesign and Affinity Photo 2 appear only in the context of Sidecar and Apple Pencil, which is an adjacent feature, not an install mechanism.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install popular desktop apps with a single click from a built-in app store
